provinceSource.note: The 1300 source contains 237 historical political/cultural GIS features. Historia AI imports them as provisional Province simulation units; they are not presented as a complete historically exact administrative-province dataset.
provinceSource.phase2: source-derived features are rendered as provinces; curated country-region overlays are retained as research metadata rather than province geometry

phase2b.policy: later political ownership is not projected backward onto 1300 without evidence

phase2c.runtimeOverlayPolicy: broad curated political overlay is research-only and is no longer imported as runtime province geometry
phase2c.terrainPolicy: broad terrain classes provide deterministic map modifiers without pretending to be a high-resolution elevation model
phase2c.settlementPolicy: relative low/medium/high density tiers only; not a population census

sourceBasis: Natural Earth 10m physical vectors — coastline, land, rivers/lake centerlines, lakes
Curated Anatolia-focused feature geometry for map readability and gameplay
physicalGeography.historicalNote: Physical geography is largely time-stable at the game's scale; political ownership is intentionally excluded from this dataset.

notes: Historical borders are approximate and source-dependent.
Province is Historia AI's runtime simulation unit; it is not a claim that every imported feature was an administrative province in 1300.
Physical geography is rendered independently from political ownership so coastlines, water and terrain cannot accidentally become political territory.
The generated source GeoJSON remains a local build artifact unless redistribution is explicitly approved by the source license.
The broad Phase 2B regional political overlay remains available for research comparison but is not imported into runtime province geometry after Phase 2C.
